name: Shiratori Mariko
source:
A 24 years old news reporter for  GUIL-TV (Global Units for Impart Line).

A female anchor in her second year with the TV station's news department. She has been selected as the main anchor for the TV station's signature news program, "Prime Time News," which airs during prime time on weekdays, and has become a popular figure among the TV audience.

A talented young lady who has studied abroad and graduated from a British university, she is also popular for her intelligent and beautiful appearance. While exuding a certain nobility, she never forgets her feminine attentiveness and gentleness. However, she also has a strong inner core, and she is incapable of forgiving any wrongdoing.

As a virgin, she has very limited sexual experience.
